L1_perforated_panel.spec: A flat panel 160 mm (X) by 100 mm (Y) by 6 mm thick (Z), spanning x 0..160, y 0..100, z 0..6. (a) 28 plain through holes of diameter 8 mm along Z, on a grid: every combination of x = 25, 45, 65, 85, 105, 125, 145 and y = 30, 45, 60, 75. (b) Four counterbored through holes, one near each corner, centred at (8,8), (152,8), (8,92) and (152,92): through hole diameter 6.6 mm, counterbore diameter 11 mm and 4 mm deep from the top face (the counterbore floor is flat at z = 2). (c) Two rectangular blind pockets cut down from the top face, each 3 mm deep with a flat floor at z = 3 and square (unrounded) corners: one spanning x 65..95, y 8..20, the other x 65..95, y 80..92. One solid body named Panel.

L1_manifold_block.spec: A rectangular block spanning x 0..120, y 0..80, z 0..50, with these features (all blind holes have flat bottoms, no drill-point cone): (a) Top face (z=50): ten blind holes of diameter 10 mm, 20 mm deep (down to z=30), centred at x = 20, 40, 60, 80, 100 for each of y = 20 and y = 60. (b) Front face (y=0): five blind holes of diameter 8 mm, 15 mm deep along +Y (to y=15), axes at z = 15 and x = 20, 40, 60, 80, 100. (c) Back face (y=80): four blind holes of diameter 8 mm, 15 mm deep along -Y (to y=65), axes at z = 15 and x = 30, 50, 70, 90. (d) Left face (x=0): two blind holes of diameter 12 mm, 25 mm deep along +X (to x=25), axes at y = 40 with z = 15 and z = 35. (e) Right face (x=120): three cylindrical bosses of diameter 16 mm protruding 6 mm in +X (to x=126), axes along X at z = 25 and y = 20, 40, 60. (f) Each boss has a coaxial blind hole of diameter 6 mm drilled from the boss end face, 26 mm deep along -X (from x=126 to x=100). One solid body named Manifold.

L1_boss_plate.spec: A base plate spanning x 0..140, y 0..90, z 0..8. (a) Twelve cylindrical bosses of diameter 14 mm standing on the top face, each 12 mm tall (z 8..20), centred at every combination of x = 25, 55, 85, 115 and y = 20, 45, 70. (b) Each boss has a coaxial through hole of diameter 6 mm running along Z through the boss and the plate (z 0..20). (c) Four plain through holes of diameter 5 mm in the plate at (6,6), (134,6), (6,84) and (134,84). (d) Two straight rectangular ribs on the top face, each 6 mm tall (z 8..14) and spanning x 10..130: one spanning y 30.5..34.5, the other y 55.5..59.5. Everything is fused into one solid body named BossPlate.
